**Bruno captain, a set-piece machine spearheading a £100m build for GW1.**

**✅ What's strong**
The spine is proper. B.Fernandes (5.02 xP) skippers it — pens, free-kicks and corners all #1, that's a captaincy no-brainer. Gabriel (4.56) is the standout defender and a smart vice, with Virgil (3.97) alongside him for clean sheets and a soft run. Midfield is loaded: Saka, Mbeumo, Enzo and Wirtz all carry real underlying threat, and Thiago plus João Pedro give you two forwards on genuine xGI. No fitness flags in the data — clean bill of health.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Fresh build, no transfers to make — so prioritise the assets that matter. Watch the rotation tags: Gabriel (~66'), Saka (~56') and Wirtz (~60') aren't fully nailed, so the ~68' minutes on Mbeumo and João Pedro carry weight. Leno at 4.5 is a tidy enabler letting you fund Bruno. Bench is thin (Mheuka and Fredricson are cameo-only), so hope you don't need them early.

**Bottom line:** Bank it, captain Bruno, and let a 43.7-point XI do the talking.
